_label: Glory at Lord-I-Call, Synaxis of the Bodiless Powers (11-08)

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

_note: Two OCA editions of one hymn. The base is the OCA service-texts DOCX (reference/scrape/2024-11-08.docx, "Prepared by the Department of Liturgical Music and Translations"); the parish sings the OCA engraved-music setting (© 2019 OCA) printed in its choir packet. Register is NOT the whole difference and a ?pronoun=yy render does not reach this wording — see memory project_register_knob_is_service_wide.

_provenance.family_note: OCA. The OCA service-texts DOCX; identical to the stichera row it stands in for.

value.text:
Rejoice with us, O Princes of the angelic Powers, for your leader and our champion, the great Chief Captain, gloriously appearing in his honored temple, sanctifies it! Therefore, rightfully singing praises to him, we cry out: “Save us under the protection of thy wings,
O Michael, the greatest archangel!”

variants.label: OCA engraved-music setting, as the parish sings it

_provenance.source_citation: docs/choir-packets/2026-11-04/pdf/great-vespers-2026-11-07.pdf p.5-6, heading "November 8: Ss. Michael & Gabriel and all the Bodiless Hosts", "Lord I Call..." Tone 4, position (Glory). Colophon on the packet's last page: "© 2019 Orthodox Church in America". Read VISUALLY from the scan, not from the OCR sidecar. Chant marks (//) kept as printed; the director's pencil underlay marks are melodic, not textual, and are not transcribed.
_provenance.family_note: OCA. A different OCA EDITION from the service-texts DOCX, not a different translator: the packet colophon reads "© 2019 Orthodox Church in America" and the hymns are the OCA Music Department's engraved settings. Declared explicitly because the citation prose names no bare "OCA" token for familyOfProse to find.

value.text:
Princes of the angelic powers rejoice with us,
for your leader and our champion
the great prince of angels is sanctified,
being revealed to us in his honored temple.
Therefore rightfully singing praises to him we cry out:
Save us under the protection of your wings,//
Michael, the greatest archangel!
